messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High sustained token latency on hosted inference (region: us-west-2). Impact: increased tail latency and 504s for v2 models. Pager: @alex (oncall). Link: https://incidents.redwood/3425012345

alex: I’m on it. seeing elevated p95/p99 for generation paths. starting triage — attaching current metric snapshot.

maya: adding context — rolled quantized 8-bit build at Tue 02:10 UTC. Canary passed but rollout hit 40% at 02:25.

jamal: Confirmed spike aligns with canary ramp. CPU vs GPU skew looks normal, but KV cache hit rate dropped ~30%.

rachel: @alex any customer-facing impact yet? support shows ~30 tickets with slower responses for embeddings/long prompts.

alex: Customers seeing timeouts for long chats (>2k tokens). 504 rate up from 0.02% -> 0.9% last 15m. Triage hypothesis: quantized runtime + batching interaction evicting KV cache entries.

li: grabbing logs for an affected host. here's a short snippet: ```ERROR inference/runtime: kv_cache_miss: key not found for seq=128 model=v2-q8 -> dropping cached_attention```

maya: That matches an earlier regression we saw in local repro when batcher coalesces variable-length requests with q8 kernels. KV cache pointers shifted.

alex: Mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary rollout to prevent further exposure. 2) Short-term: force older q4 runtime on canary group and enable strict batching limits. 3) LR rollback if needed. Executing step 1 now.

incident-bot: Canary rollout paused by alex at 02:42 UTC.

jamal: Implemented request size gating -> set max_batch_tokens=2048 and per-request max_concurrency=2 for affected pool. Metrics look better in a few hosts. p99 reduced.

rachel: Notifying CS: posted status update to customers in affected orgs. Tagging priority customers for manual outreach.

alex: Confirming partial mitigation: global 504 rate back to 0.12% after gating and pause. Still tracking KV hit rate trend.

maya: We should schedule a postmortem with runtime, oncall, and model-onboarding teams. Also need an action item list with owners and ETA.

li: Recording initial POA for post-incident follow-up doc: root cause narrow -> interaction between q8 kernel memory layout + batcher merging logic causing stale KV pointers on cache boundary conditions.

tara: I’ll own the postmortem doc + timeline. Propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Draft agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, rollout safety checks, test coverage.

jamal: For remediation tracking I propose three parallel tracks: 1) Runtime patch to make KV cache robust to layout changes (owner: jamal) 2) Batcher hardening to avoid coalescing incompatible shapes (owner: maya) 3) Canary policy changes + gated rollout automation (owner: li).

alex: Assign owners confirmed. Please add sub-tasks with estimates. Also add backout playbook and automations to detect KV pointer anomalies.

kvcache-team: Quick note — we have a lightweight detector we can push to prod as a metric: kv_pointer_validation_failures. I'll open a PR today.

maya: I'll add unit + integration tests that simulate mixed-length coalescing with q8 kernel path. Need 5 d for tests + 2 d for rollout.

jamal: Runtime patch looks like ~4d dev + 1d staging + staged rollout. Keeping priority P0.

li: Canary policy change: default canary window -> 1h with autoscale backoff; automated pause on kv_pointer_validation_failures > 0.1% over 5m. I'll file infra change. ETA 3d.

tara: Postmortem scheduled: 3425090000 (tomorrow 14:00 UTC). I'll make calendar invite and ownership table in the doc. Everyone here pls review and add notes to the doc: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/3425012345-kv-batch-quant

rachel: Action items for CS: continue customer outreach, log impacted request ids to link to telemetry. I'll coordinate with support.

alex: Closing loop on immediate mitigation: canary paused, gating added, support notified. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. We'll re-open if symptoms re-emerge.

incident-bot: Incident mitigation noted by alex at 03:56 UTC. Severity downgraded to SEV3.

jamal: Follow-up: I'll open a tracking ticket in the remediation board with 3 child tasks (runtime patch, batcher tests, canary policy). Will link PRs and dates.

li: Pushing kv_pointer metric to dashboards now. Expect alerts in 30m.

maya: Quick QA note — we discovered an edge-case in our emulation harness that missed the cache layout change. Adding test harness fix as low-effort quick win.

tara: Done: postmortem doc created with initial timeline and owner table. Please add rough ETAs so I can set milestones.

alex: Thanks team. Postmortem owners, please update the remediation ticket with clear acceptance criteria: no regressed 504s at p99 for 48h after rollout + kv_pointer_validation_failures < 0.05% in prod.

kvcache-team: Will add validation checks and a canary metric. Will also draft a rollback checklist.

jamal: I'll keep this thread updated with PR links and deployment windows. Planning to start runtime patch work in 6h (blocking: internal code freeze window).

rachel: Noted — I'll prepare customer-facing postmortem summary draft for review after internal postmortem.

alex: Great. If anything urgent crops up ping @alex. Otherwise reconvene in doc/meeting. :thumbsup:
